search.source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (Google's own plain-text documentation https://aistudio.google.com/llms-full.txt, read directly 2026-11-15): grounding with Google Search 5,000 free requests per month shared across Gemini 3 and newer models, then $14 per 1,000 requests, daily cap 1,500. Search is NOT enabled in this deployment; treated as billable from the first request to stay conservative.

models.source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (official plain text, read directly 2026-11-15): paid tier per 1M tokens: input $0.30 (text/image/video/audio); output $2.50 INCLUDING thinking tokens; context caching $0.03. Free tier: content is used to improve Google products; paid tier: it is not.
models.note: Recommended for chat: fastest and cheapest current model. Thinking level default is minimal.

models.source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing (official plain text, read directly 2026-11-15): input $0.75 through 2026-12-31 and $1.50 from 2027-01-01; output including thinking $3.75 through 2026-12-31 and $7.50 from 2027-01-01; caching $0.075 then $0.15.
models.note: Default thinking level is medium (billed as output; minimal is rejected). Prices double on 2027-01-01.
